items.summaryOriginal: In this post, you will learn how to deploy and host your MCP server in AgentCore Runtime and integrate it with Amazon Quick, along with the prerequisites. With this pattern, you promote reusability and avoid duplication of AI tools, so clients can reuse commonly used tools and agents exposed through an MCP server instead of authoring them from scratch again. Your customers get a way to use your product inside Amazon Quick (chat agents and workflows) without building custom connectors for every use case.

items.titleOriginal: Apple introduces M6 and M5 Ultra for a big leap in performance and AI compute
items.summary: طرحت شركة آبل هاتف M6 في ماك ميني الجديد و M5 Ultra في ماك ستوديو الجديد، مما يوفر قفزة استثنائية في الأداء وقدرات الذكاء الاصطناعي.
items.summaryOriginal: Apple debuted M6 in the new Mac mini and M5 Ultra in the new Mac Studio, providing an extraordinary leap in performance and AI capabilities.
items.why: قد يغيّر قدرات الأدوات أو طريقة استخدامها، لذلك يستحق المتابعة من المصدر الرسمي.
